resolvedStack: React Native / Expo + Next.js 14 Web Preview + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: FieldPulse Site Inspector
description: FieldPulse Site Inspector is a cross-platform mobile application for construction site engineers to complete safety checklists, log structural defects, and sync inspection reports in real time with NextAuth and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: FieldPulse Site Inspector
metadata.description: Cross-platform mobile app for construction site inspections, defect logs, and safety alerts.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, React Native / Expo preview compatible deps, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
Expo app configuration for FieldPulse Site Inspector.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, InspectionStatus, DefectSeverity enums and User, SiteInspection, DefectLog, SafetyAlert models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for SiteInspection, DefectLog, SafetyAlert.
Tailwind CSS base styles for mobile-first UI.
Root layout wrapping SessionProvider, Navbar, main content, and Footer.
Mobile welcome landing screen for FieldPulse Site Inspector with CTA to /dashboard.
Mobile inspection dashboard showing active sites, open defects, and safety alerts.
Site inspections checklist screen with status filters and new inspection form.
Defect tracking screen with severity badges and log form.
Registration screen calling POST /api/register then signing in.
Client hook fetching /api/inspections on mount via useEffect with safe array defaults.
Client hook fetching /api/defects on mount via useEffect with safe array defaults.
Registration endpoint creating user via Prisma.
GET and POST API route for SiteInspection records.
GET and POST API route for DefectLog records.
